header.title: BlurUnveil
header.description: Goes from blurred to sharp (or the other way), with a slight zoom. `variant` sets the pattern (`in`, `out` or `pulse`) and `trigger` when it runs: by default (`always`) it plays once on mount. Meant for loading images or content being revealed.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Combine the props and see the generated code. With `trigger="always"` the animation runs only once: use Replay to see it again. With `pulse`, raise `duration` (it's the length of each cycle).

image.title: On an image
image.description: With the defaults (`variant="in"`, `trigger="always"`) the image starts blurred and slightly enlarged, and becomes sharp in `700ms`. It only runs on mount. The root clips (`overflow: hidden`), so it carries the `border-radius`.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: `in` goes from blurred to sharp, `out` from sharp to blurred and `pulse` loops between the two.

triggers.title: Triggers
triggers.description: With `hover` and `click`, `in` stays blurred at rest and turns sharp on hover or click. With `hover`, keyboard focus (on the root or on a control inside) sharpens it too. `always` plays once on mount.

spoiler.title: Spoiler
spoiler.description: `trigger="click"` with `scale={1}` works to hide content until the person chooses to see it. Click the card to reveal it and again to hide it. With `tabIndex={0}` the root is focusable: tab to it and toggle with Enter or Space.

texts.title: Season finale
texts.body: The hero was the villain since the very first episode.

blur.title: Blur
blur.description: `blur` sets the peak blur and replaces the one from `intensity`. A number is pixels; a string is used as is (`"1.5rem"`). Hover to sharpen each one.

scale.title: Scale
scale.description: `scale` is the zoom while blurred; it goes back to `1` when sharp. With `scale={1}` the size doesn't change. Values below `1` are treated as `1`.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: `duration` is how long it takes to sharpen (or the full cycle, with `pulse`). `delay` postpones the start.

intensity.title: Intensity
intensity.description: When `blur` and `scale` are omitted, `intensity` sets them: `sm` 8px and 1.02, `md` 18px and 1.06, `lg` 32px and 1.1. It takes a token or a number between `0` and `1`. Here with `hover` to show the resting blur.

asChild.title: asChild
asChild.description: With `asChild`, the effect is applied to the child without a wrapping `div`. Here, straight on an `img` with `trigger="hover"` and `scale={1}`. There's no root to clip, so the blur shows a bit past the edges: use the default `div` if you want it clipped.

state.title: Paused and disabled
state.description: `isPaused` freezes the blur and scale where they are, for any variant and trigger: the `pulse` beat, the `always` entrance or a `hover` or `click` transition halfway through. When unpaused it continues from there. `isDisabled` keeps the content sharp and interactive.

callbacks.title: Events
callbacks.description: `onBlurUnveil` fires when the effect turns on and `outBlurUnveil` when it turns off, with the cause in `event.reason`. The button still gets clicks even while blurred.

texts.body: Hover over the card to see it sharp and click the button.

header.title: BlurUnveil API
header.description: Reference for the props, inheritance, accessibility, CSS classes and variables, and exported types of `BlurUnveil`.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: Playground and examples of each variant, trigger and option.

import.title: Import
import.description: Import it from `@gem-org/gemffects/blur-unveil` with its `blur-unveil.css`, or from the root if you already load `styles.css`.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Accepts the attributes of HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> and passes them to the root div (or to the child, with asChild). onClick, onKeyDown, onPointerEnter, onPointerLeave, onFocus and onBlur run before the effect's internal logic.

items.reducedMotion: With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce the content stays sharp and at scale 1 for every variant and trigger: the animations, the transitions and the resting blur are removed.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: ignoreReducedMotion (or the gemfx-ignore-reduced-motion class on an ancestor) forces the motion. Only use it if it's essential.
items.hidden: The blur is visual only: the content stays in the DOM and screen readers read it. Don't use it as the only way to hide sensitive information.
items.keyboard: With trigger="hover", keyboard focus (:focus-visible on the root or inside) counts as hover: the content sharpens and onBlurUnveil and outBlurUnveil fire. A mouse click that focuses a button doesn't keep it sharp.
items.click: With trigger="click" the toggle listens to the root's click, so a button inside toggles with Enter and Space. If the root is focusable (tabIndex={0}, as in the spoiler), Enter and Space on it toggle too.
items.performance: filter: blur() is expensive on large elements. Avoid many pulse instances at once.

items.root: Root. `position: relative`, `inline-flex`, `isolation: isolate` and `overflow: hidden` to clip the zoom and the blur.
items.trigger: Active trigger. With `hover` and `click`, `in` stays blurred until `--on` appears.
items.on: Added while active: with the pointer or keyboard focus on it (`hover`) or toggled on (`click`).
items.paused: Added with `isPaused`. Pauses the `always` and `pulse` animations. With `hover` and `click`, the component pins the current blur and scale inline for as long as it's paused.
items.inactive: Added with `isActive={false}` or `isDisabled`. Keeps the surface sharp and at scale `1`.
items.surface: Wraps the child. It gets the `filter: blur()` and the `transform: scale()`. With `asChild` it's the child itself.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: All of them are written inline on the root on every render, so a class can't override them: tune them with the props. The curves can be changed through the tokens.

items.duration: Transition length (or `pulse` cycle). Set by `duration`; default `700ms`.
items.blur: Peak blur. Comes from `blur` or `intensity` (`18px` by default).
items.scale: Scale while blurred. Comes from `scale` or `intensity` (`1.06` by default).

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.description: Global variables BlurUnveil reads as defaults. They can be redefined on the root with a class.

items.easingEmphasized: Curve for `in`, `out` and the `hover` and `click` transitions.

content.title: Content
content.description: Which content blurs and where the effect is mounted.

timing.title: Timing
timing.description: Duration (or `pulse` cycle) and delay, in milliseconds.

state.title: Trigger and state
state.description: When it runs and how it's paused or turned off.

items.children: Content being revealed, typically an image.
items.asChild: Applies the effect to the only child, without a wrapping `div`. It blurs the child itself, so the blur and zoom aren't clipped. It injects no layers, so it works with void elements (`img`): the element itself becomes the root.
items.variant: `in` from blurred to sharp, `out` from sharp to blurred, `pulse` loops between them.
items.blur: Peak blur. A number is pixels (negative values are treated as `0`); a string is used as is. When omitted, `intensity` sets it: `8`, `18` or `32` px.
items.scale: Scale while blurred. When omitted, `intensity` sets it: `1.02`, `1.06` or `1.1`. Minimum `1`.
items.intensity: Sets `blur` and `scale` when missing. A token or a number between `0` and `1`.
items.duration: Transition length, or full cycle with `pulse`. Negative values are treated as `0`.
items.trigger: `always` plays once on mount (`pulse` loops), `hover` while the pointer or keyboard focus is on it, `click` toggles on each click (or with Enter and Space when the root has focus).
items.isActive: Allows the effect. With `false` the content stays sharp and `outBlurUnveil` gets `inactive`.
items.isPaused: Freezes the current blur and scale for any variant, also mid-transition. While paused, clicks don't toggle with `trigger="click"`.
items.isDisabled: Stops the effect; the child stays sharp and interactive. `outBlurUnveil` gets `disabled`.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: Animates even if the user prefers reduced motion. Only if essential.
items.onBlurUnveil: Fires when the effect turns on: on pointer or keyboard focus enter, when toggled on by click or keyboard, or on mount with `always`.
items.outBlurUnveil: Fires when it turns off: on pointer or focus leave, when toggled off by click or keyboard, on disable or on unmount.
items.style: Inline styles for the root. Merged with the `--gemfx-blur-unveil-*` variables.
items.ref: Ref to the root (the `div`, or the child with `asChild`).
